'''Bixite''' is a [[Minerals#Geode Minerals|mineral]] that can be found in the [[Magma Geode]] and the [[Omni Geode]].  It can also be dropped by [[Slimes|Black Slimes]].

==Bundles==
Bixite is not used in any [[bundles]].

==Recipes==
Bixite is not used in any recipes.

==Tailoring==
Bixite is used in the spool of the [[2 Willow Lane#Sewing Machine|Sewing Machine]] with [[Cloth]] in the feed to create a {{Name|Shirt101|link=Tailoring{{!}}Shirt|class=inline}}. It is a black dye when used in the spool of the Sewing Machine with a dyeable clothing item in the feed.

==Quests==
Bixite is not used in any [[quests]].

==History==
{{History|1.4|Can now be used in [[Tailoring]].}}
